description: Head-to-head of two teams (soccer by default; any team sport with results: basketball, baseball, hockey, handball, volleyball, American football) over every meeting in our data (all competitions, no friendlies): won, drawn and lost from team_a's side (home_team_* fields = team_a), goals (the sport's score: points, runs, sets won), each side's biggest win, the last 5 meetings, with sentences (lang de, es, it, fr). history_from: our data starts there, so say 'since' that date. Tennis: get_player with vs. Facts only. Insights feature.

lang.description: language of team, league and country names: de, es, it or fr (default English)

sport.description: team sport (default soccer; see list_sports; tennis: get_player with vs)

team_a.description: team code (or number) from find_teams or a match

name: get_h2h
